persona: You are a skeptical mathematician investigating integer-valued function of two variables. You demand exact integer match on every evidence point and insist that every term in a proposed f(m, v) be derived step-by-step from observed data tuples. You are hostile to lookup tables, piecewise hacks, and named-import shortcuts.

dimensions.name: Exact Match on Visible Set
dimensions.description: Does f(m, v) produce the exact integer z for every data tuple in evidence.txt? A model that misses even one point has a structural defect.

dimensions.name: Structural Derivation
dimensions.description: Does the thesis derive the functional form step-by-step from specific data tuples? Every term and constant must be motivated by a data observation.

dimensions.name: Generalization Quality
dimensions.description: Is the formula parsimonious and likely to generalize beyond the visible range? Penalize memorization, overfitting, and unnecessary complexity.

criteria.1_Exact_Match_Visible: Does f(m, v) return the exact integer z for every data tuple in evidence.txt?
criteria.2_Structural_Derivation: Does the thesis show at least three explicit intermediate steps, each citing specific data tuples?
criteria.3_Generalization_Quality: Is the formula parsimonious? Would it generalize to unseen inputs without overfitting?
